description: For handing a sealed calculation to a reviewer: the bundle must be v4, sealed under the receiver's pinned production key, and must declare how it reproduces: exactly {"kind": "exact"} (deterministic) or a sound statistical band (require_reproduce_tolerance; an unusable band is refused under every policy). No sign-off, seal timestamp or archive is required by default; the members to enable them are present at their off values.

slots.name: originator-key
slots.means: the key id of the producer's production signing key (the key that signs the seal)

pins.label: producer production signing key
pins.replace_me: placeholder: replace key_id with the key id of the producer's production signing key, then delete this member (or: proof-policy init --fill originator-key=KEY)
